name: Roger Williams

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: COMBATING FOREIGN THREATS TO MAIN STREET ACT OF 2026
statements.title: COMBATING FOREIGN THREATS TO MAIN STREET ACT OF 2026
sentences: Mr. Speaker, I move to suspend the rules and pass the bill (H.R. 10329) to require the Administrator of the Small Business Administration to disseminate information on foreign adversary conduct that poses material harm to small business concerns, and for other purposes.
China, Russia, and North Korea are working to undermine our economic and national security, and American businesses are increasingly caught in the crosshairs.

The Chinese Communist Party, in particular, is an expert at stealing intellectual property, exploiting unfair trade practices, and using predatory investment to gain economic advantage at our expense.
It requires the SBA to develop and publish educational materials on foreign adversary conduct that poses material harm to small businesses and their concerns.
Mr. Speaker, I rise today in strong support of H.R. 10329, the Combating Foreign Threats to Main Street Act of 2026.
I introduced this bill alongside the gentleman from California (Mr. Tran), my friend.
I urge all my colleagues to support my bill, H.R. 10329.

Mr. Speaker, I urge my colleagues to vote in favor of H.R. 10329 to strengthen small business awareness of foreign threats, protect American innovation, and safeguard the security and the competitiveness of small businesses across our Nation.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: SMALL BUSINESS TECHNOLOGICAL ADVANCEMENT ACT
statements.title: SMALL BUSINESS TECHNOLOGICAL ADVANCEMENT ACT
sentences: H.R. 915 provides an important clarification and removes any ambiguity to ensure that small businesses can use SBA 7(a) loans to purchase and upgrade technological systems and business software, including those that utilize artificial intelligence, to support their daily operations.

Mr. Speaker, I rise today in strong support of H.R. 915, the Small Business Technological Advancement Act, introduced by my friends the gentleman from Missouri (Mr. Alford) and the gentlewoman from Nevada (Ms. Lee).
Once again, I thank Representatives Alford and Lee for introducing this timely legislation, and I urge all of my colleagues to vote in support of H.R. 915.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: SBA ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE UTILIZATION ACT OF 2026
statements.title: SBA ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE UTILIZATION ACT OF 2026
sentences: Mr. Speaker, I move to suspend the rules and pass the bill (H.R. 8881) to amend the Small Business Act to require the Administrator of the Small Business Administration to report on the use of artificial intelligence and machine learning by the Administration, and for other purposes.

Mr. Speaker, I rise today in strong support of H.R. 8881, the SBA Artificial Intelligence Utilization Act of 2026, introduced by Representative Finstad from the great State of Minnesota and Representative Latimer from the great State of New York.
Artificial intelligence is rapidly transforming how businesses operate.
The Small Business Administration plays a critical role in supporting entrepreneurs and job creators across this Nation.
H.R. 8881 requires the SBA to submit annual reports to Congress regarding the agency's use of artificial intelligence and machine learning technologies.

By providing regular information to the SBA's use of artificial intelligence, this legislation will help promote a more efficient and accountable government while ensuring that innovation is paired with appropriate oversight and human judgment.
Mr. Speaker, I urge my colleagues to vote in favor of H.R. 8881 to help modernize the SBA and ensure the agency can better serve America's small business.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: MAIN STREET COMPETES ACT
statements.title: MAIN STREET COMPETES ACT
sentences: Mr. Speaker, I move to suspend the rules and pass the bill (H.R. 8882) to amend the Small Business Economic Policy Act of 1980 to examine how the competitiveness of small businesses is affected by the enforcement of Federal antitrust laws, and for other purposes.

This bill requires the Department of Justice and the Federal Trade Commission to share data with SBA Office of Advocacy regarding antitrust complaints, investigations, and enforcement actions involving small businesses.
This is a targeted, data-driven approach to better understand competitive pressures in the marketplace and to assess whether existing antitrust enforcement is effectively protecting small businesses.

Mr. Speaker, I rise today in strong support of H.R. 8882, the Main Street Competes Act, introduced by my good friend Representative Scholten from the great State of Michigan and Representative Schmidt from the great State of Kansas.
Mr. Speaker, I urge my colleagues to vote in favor of H.R. 8882 because it promotes a stronger, more competitive environment for the Main Street of America and businesses to succeed and create jobs.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: MAIN STREET PARITY ACT
statements.title: MAIN STREET PARITY ACT
sentences: Madam Speaker, I move to suspend the rules and pass the bill (H.R. 5763) to amend the Small Business Investment Act of 1958 to modify the criteria for loans for plant acquisition, construction, conversion or expansion, and for other purposes.
The SBA's 504 loan program is an important tool that helps small businesses obtain affordable financing for the acquisition of fixed assets, such as land, buildings, and heavy machinery.
To obtain a 504 loan, a small business owner must contribute 10 percent of the total project cost as a form of downpayment.
Madam Speaker, I rise today in strong support of my bill, H.R. 5763, the Main Street Parity Act.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: AI FOR MAIN STREET ACT
statements.title: AI FOR MAIN STREET ACT
sentences: Madam Speaker, I move to suspend the rules and pass the bill (H.R. 5764) to amend the Small Business Act to require small business development centers to assist small business concerns with the use of artificial intelligence, and for other purposes, as amended.
Artificial intelligence is increasingly being used to streamline operations, reduce costs, and boost productivity for small businesses.
As artificial intelligence becomes a core driver of productivity and competitiveness, Main Street cannot be left behind.
Madam Speaker, I rise today in strong support of H.R. 5764, the AI for Main Street Act, introduced by Representatives Alford and Scholten.
I urge my colleagues to support H.R. 5764, the AI for Main Street Act.
I urge my colleagues to support this commonsense legislation.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: 504 PROGRAM RISK OVERSIGHT ACT
statements.title: 504 PROGRAM RISK OVERSIGHT ACT
sentences: The 504 program is an incredibly important tool that helps small businesses obtain long-term, fixed-rate financing like the acquisition of fixed assets such as land, buildings, and heavy machinery.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE WISDOM FOR INNOVATIVE SMALL ENTERPRISES ACT
statements.title: ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE WISDOM FOR INNOVATIVE SMALL ENTERPRISES ACT
sentences: Madam Speaker, I move to suspend the rules and pass the bill (H.R. 5784) to amend the Small Business Act to help small business concerns critically evaluate artificial intelligence tools, and for other purposes.
Madam Speaker, I rise in support of H.R. 5784, the Artificial Intelligence Wisdom for Innovative Small Enterprises Act, the AI-WISE Act.
Artificial intelligence is changing how businesses operate in real time.
This bill directs the SBA to provide clear, accessible, and practical guidance that helps small business owners understand artificial intelligence in straightforward terms.

It focuses on helping entrepreneurs evaluate whether an artificial intelligence tool is useful for their specific business, where it may fall short, and whether it is truly worth the cost before they spend their money to get that.
Madam Speaker, we cannot leave Main Street behind in the adoption of AI.
I urge my colleagues to support this commonsense, bipartisan legislation and to vote ``yes'' on H.R. 5784.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: CHINA FINANCIAL THREAT MITIGATION ACT OF 2025
statements.title: CHINA FINANCIAL THREAT MITIGATION ACT OF 2025

These predatory practices harm American businesses, erode trust in global markets, and risk empowering China to pressure developing nations and destabilize debt markets for its own benefit.

That is why I introduced the China Financial Threat Mitigation Act.
